content: Canonical 7a/7c/7l (ARM64 Plan 9 assembler/compiler/linker) sources live in 9front: git.9front.org/plan9front/plan9front, GitHub mirror github.com/9front/9front branch 'front', at sys/src/cmd/7a (a.h,a.y,lex.c,mkfile), sys/src/cmd/7c (cgen.c,enam.c,gc.h,list.c,machcap.c,mul.c,peep.c,reg.c,sgen.c,swt.c,txt.c,7.out.h; mkfile T=7 depends on ../cc/cc.h and ../cc/compat.h), sys/src/cmd/7l (asm,asmout,enam,bits,cnam,compat,dyn,list,noop,obj,optab,span,pass,mod). Same code, host-ported for unix, also in 0intro/9-cc src/cmd/{7a,7c,7l}. Verified by direct fetch of repo contents.
